server.notes: Files outside server/ that the server imports. The host copies these, levels/ and this manifest next to server/, keeping the repo layout.

frame.yaw: 0 points along +x; positive yaw turns from +x towards +y (clockwise on screen, because y points down)

core.notes: The Void Core moves only when both handles are held. Each carrier's input is a wanted velocity at its handle; the core translates with the mean and turns with the difference across the bar.

inputs.aimX: cursor point on the ground, game units
inputs.aimY: cursor point on the ground, game units
inputs.interact: button held: revive a partner or hold a core handle

intents.pick: message {level, skill}: choose one skill from the offer for that level
intents.reroll: message {level}: replace the skills offered for that level, once

private_messages.offer: {level, choices, rerollUsed}: the skills offered to one player after a level-up (what that player was shown)

messages.ping: {x, y, kind}, re-broadcast as {from, x, y, z, target, kind}
messages.rate: {score} 1-5, the partner vote, re-broadcast with the episode
messages.ui: {shown}: panels shown to the player (written to players.<id>.shown)

consent.notice: By joining a room you agree that the session, including chat and pings, is recorded as Stateloop play data.
consent.shown: in the online lobby, next to Quick Match / Create Private Room / Join with Code
consent.platform: players reach the game through the Stateloop play portal (signed in); the server cannot verify that per seat
